messages.subject: plotting issues
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,
I have got some issues concerning the plot of the tree with ranges after running an analysis based on the GeoSSE model. It seems that the ancestral ranges are not correctly indicated. Is there any solution? Has somebody got a similar error?
My best regards,
José Ricardo.

messages.subject: Probabilities of per-area probability table do not sum to one
messages.subject_clean: Probabilities of per-area probability table do not sum to one
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr. Matzke,

I hope you are well.

I have a question about the output tables of biogeobears analyses. It is about the table with the per-area probabilities (http://phylo.wikidot.com/example-biogeobears-scripts#per-area_probabilities), probabilities of this table do not sum to one; meanwhile, the table of probabilities of states/ranges at each node does. Why is that?

Thanks!

messages.subject: BioGeoBEARS through RASP
messages.body_plain:
Hey everyone!
I'm pretty new to biogeography, especially with the BioGeoBEARS package. I'm still getting used to dealing with R, to be honest.
I would like to try to run the models (DIVA, DEC, BAYAREA) through RASP, but every time I try to run it seems that the R tab doesn't work and when I click "x", I find some errors that I don't know how to solve...

The following errors appear to me:

"Process begin at 10/21/2022 10:27:16 PM
ERROR:STOP ERROR in bears_optim_run(). For some reason, your ML optimizer returned one or more NA / NaN values for the estimated parameters. Probably this is a version conflict with an update to one of the optimizer functions/packages (e.g., optim, optimx, minqa, GenSA. Printing "BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table" to screen, below"

I tried the Tools>Scaling Branch Length option and ran it again, but:

"ERROR:Cannot evaluate function at initial parameters"

Could someone give me some help? I would be very grateful
